Maya Patel: quick notei found an outdated prefetch example in optimize/batching.md that still uses global `kv_prefetch`. opening a small PR to switch to route-scoped caching, add short-seq guidance, and include tiny py + go snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13321
Alex Chen: great. please show the short-seq settings (for <64 tokens) and an example `max_batch_tokens` value engineers can copy.
Maya Patel: added this minimal Python snippet to the PR description:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.optimize.update_route_config("chat-route", {
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 900, "short_seq_mode": True},
  "caching": {"kv_prefetch": {"enabled": True, "prefix_cache_size": 300}}
})
```
Jordan Rivera: SDK heads-up: method name `update_route_config` matches v0.8+. prefer nesting kv_prefetch under `caching` (you have that). add a one-line migration note about avoiding global prefetch to prevent cross-route evictions.
Maya Patel: added a migration bullet: "Migrate global kv_prefetch to route-scoped caching to avoid cross-route evictions and unpredictable TTLs."
Samir Gupta: can you also add a compact Go snippet for private/dedicated users? show ShortSeqMode + PrefixCacheSize fields and a streaming hint.
Maya Patel: added Go example:```go
import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"
client := sdk.NewClient()
cfg := sdk.RouteConfig{
  Batching: sdk.Batching{MaxBatchTokens: 900, ShortSeqMode: true},
  Caching: sdk.Caching{KVPrefetch: sdk.KVPrefetch{Enabled: true, PrefixCacheSize: 300}},
}
client.UpdateRouteConfig("chat-route", cfg)
```
DocsBot: docs-pr-checker: running link+anchor audit for PR #13321
Alex Chen: add one sentence about fallback quant profiles: when routing to cheaper fallback models recommend `qprofile: balanced-16bit` rather than `small-8bit` to reduce hallucination regressions.
Maya Patel: added fallback quant note and linked to optimize/quant-profiles.md. also fixed a broken `#kv-prefetch` anchor by redirecting batching.md -> caching.md and renaming anchors to `#kv-prefetch-route`.
Jordan Rivera: reviewed, left two tiny style nits (Go import path and a comment). added a short empirical note: internal tests showed ~25-35% p95 reduction for <64 token sequences with short_seq_mode.
Maya Patel: addressed nits and merged. changelog: `docs: replace global prefetch example with route-scoped caching; add short-seq guidance and py/go snippets; include fallback quant note; fix kv-prefetch anchor`
Alex Chen: thanks for the quick triage. :rocket:
